name: Packed half2 scalar product
description: A packed half2 SIMD dot product computed via explicit __hfma2/__hadd2 intrinsics and via native half2 operator overloads, each with a grid-stride multiply-accumulate and a shared-memory tree reduction to one partial per block.
output_description: CUDA executable writes numeric output to output/cuda_output.txt.

performance.notes: Runtime logs are written by tools/benchmark_case.py.

extraction_notes: scalarProductKernel_native/_intrinsics and reduceInShared_native/_intrinsics reproduced verbatim from NVIDIA/cuda-samples fp16ScalarProduct.cu. Host driver, gen_a_lane/gen_b_lane, CMakeLists, and Python oracle are new. Inputs chosen so every fp16 intermediate is an exact integer. Snapshot sk-08.
notes: Real-extraction fp16 case from collection snapshot sk-08. size=262144, 128 blocks x 128 threads; every block partial totals 4096. Output = intrinsics kernel per-block partials, exact oracle.
